$comment: Shared chunking cases, run by test/chunk.test.js and python/tests/test_chunk.py. Both runtimes chunk with the same heuristic counter, so identical input must produce byte-identical records -- otherwise a document chunked in the browser and one chunked by the package would embed and retrieve differently. Generated from the Python implementation, whose behaviour is independently asserted in test_chunk.py; regenerate deliberately, never to make a failing test pass.
